title: Window Options Inline Label Controls
description: Window options must be efficient: label and control on the same row when they fit (e.g. LOD dropdown should not be a nested tree item under LOD group). Flatten single-child measure groups and put labels on select/slider controls directly.
summary: Flattened redundant single-child window measure groups so short labels (LOD, Compute) sit on the same row as their select control via WindowMeasureTreeLeaf. Updated flow, procedural, dag, puzzle 2d/5d, and CAD play controllers plus related tests.
